title: ProBuild Rewards Purchase Points Accounting Rule
content:
Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards credits perks points on each credited purchase at the earning rate of the tier, within a yearly ceiling on points earned.

## Definition of purchase points

The points on a credited purchase are its pre-tax qualifying amount multiplied by the tier's points per pre-tax qualifying dollar, and multiplied again by the tier's extra multiplier for purchases paid with a Ridgeline Pro Credit account when the purchase was paid with a Ridgeline Pro Credit account. The resulting product is rounded down once, to a whole point. The points are posted as points earned on the purchase basis, referencing the spend credit of that purchase.

## Which purchases earn

Tool rental charges earn points only where the tier provides points on tool rental; installation payments only where the tier provides points on installation contract payments; special orders only where the tier provides points on special order purchases; and purchases priced under a volume pricing quote only where the tier provides points on quote-priced purchases. The tier is the one held on the purchase date.

## When points can be used

Purchase points become redeemable the tier's waiting period, in days, after the purchase date; that date is their available date. Bonus points are available at once.

## Yearly ceiling

The points earned on the membership in the program year may not exceed the tier's yearly maximum; points beyond the cap are not credited.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Hypothetical input | Working | Points |
|---|---|---|
| USD 1234.56 at a rate of 1.25 points per dollar, paid by bank card | 1234.56 multiplied by 1.25 is 1543.20; rounded down | 1543 |
| USD 1234.56 at a rate of 1.50, Ridgeline Pro Credit multiplier 1.25, paid with a Ridgeline Pro Credit account | 1234.56 multiplied by 1.50 is 1851.84; multiplied by 1.25 is 2314.80; rounded down | 2314 |
| USD 89.99 at a rate of 1.10, paid in cash | 89.99 multiplied by 1.10 is 98.989; rounded down | 98 |

**Ceiling (hypothetical).** With a yearly maximum of 100000 points and 99800 points already earned in the program year, a purchase whose points come to 500 is credited 200 points; the other 300 lie beyond the cap and are not credited.

**Available date (hypothetical).** A purchase dated 10 May with a waiting period of 30 days has an available date of 9 June. A tier bonus credited on 10 May is available on 10 May.

## Input, judgement, output

- Input: a credited tool rental charge; the tier held on the purchase date does not provide points on tool rental. Output: no purchase points.
- Input: a credited purchase priced under a volume pricing quote; the tier held on the purchase date provides points on quote-priced purchases. Output: purchase points under the definition above.
